text: Retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, retrieves relevant documents before a language model produces an answer. The retrieved passages provide evidence, so the model can ground its response in the knowledge base.
title: RAG overview

text: Hybrid retrieval combines dense vector search with lexical BM25 search. Reciprocal rank fusion merges their ranked lists, and a reranker can prioritize the strongest evidence before context construction.
title: Hybrid retrieval

text: A corporation is a legal business entity that is separate from its owners. It can own property, enter contracts, sue or be sued, and generally protects owners from personal responsibility for the corporation's debts. Corporations are commonly owned by shareholders and managed by directors and officers under applicable law.
title: Corporation basics
